status_when_written: Fixed before any scoring of larger modules. Written after the discovery tallies of code/x13_discover.py (Pfam, gene order, strand and spacing of the lut collection; KOfam typing of PQQ dehydrogenases from lut_loci used only to describe chains) and after the first post hoc two-gene scoring of this workstream. No locus of any method output was read to choose a rule. Everything scored on lut from these rules is POST HOC.
chain: co-oriented chain = maximal run of genes on one contig and one strand with every intergenic gap <= 500 bp (the Spicy notes' co-orientation protocol). 'in chain' means inside the anchor's chain; 'window w' limits members to genes within w positions of the anchor.

elements.PQQDH: Pfam PQQ or PQQ_2, 500-700 aa (the notes' operational xoxF; includes the large MDH subunit of mxa clusters)
elements.PQQE: Radical_SAM or SPASM or Fer4_12 or Fer4_14, 300-450 aa
elements.ORF6: rescue3 token 298295 (lut_loci orf6-like; a sequence family without Pfam: the one non-Pfam element, flagged)
elements.ORF7: rescue3 token 361272 (lut_loci orf7-like; flagged as ORF6)
elements.H4X: GHMP_kinases_N or Mpt_N or ATP-grasp_3 or CitG or RimK
elements.LFX: DUF3280 or 4HFCP_synth or AA_kinase or Flavoprotein or DUF6513 or DUF447_N or Polyketide_cyc2
elements.TBX: Formyl_trans_N or Pep_deformylase or PseudoU_synth_2 or EamA or AA_kinase
elements.LANMW: EF-hand protein 100-200 aa with no other Pfam row (wide lanmodulin-like anchor of the first pass)

X0_xoxF_CBB3.rule: first-pass M01: PQQDH and CBB3 neighbors, same strand, gap <= 500 bp

X1_xoxF_CBB3_SBP3.rule: anchor PQQDH; in chain, window 4: >= 1 CBB3 and >= 1 SBP3; no MDH in the chain

X2r_xoxF_CBB3_SBP3_Rhodanese.rule: X1 plus >= 1 RHOD in chain, window 5

X2t_xoxF_CBB3_ABCtransporter.rule: anchor PQQDH; in chain, window 8: CBB3, NMT1, BPD1, ABC each >= 1; no MDH in the chain
X2t_xoxF_CBB3_ABCtransporter.members: PQQDH, nearest CBB3, SBP3 and RR when in window, nearest NMT1, BPD1, ABC

X3_orf6_orf7_extension.rule: NOT a truth module: protocol test only. For each X1 instance, ORF6/ORF7 within 10 genes counted as in chain / opposite strand / absent; becomes a module only if in chain in >= 80% of the instances where present

MX0_mxaF_J_G_I.rule: anchor PQQDH; in chain, window 5: MDH, SBP3, and CBB3 or CYTC
MX0_mxaF_J_G_I.members: PQQDH, nearest SBP3, nearest CBB3/CYTC, nearest MDH

MX1_mxa_cluster.rule: anchor PQQDH; in chain, window 14: MDH, DUF58, MOXR, VWA each >= 1
MX1_mxa_cluster.members: PQQDH + every SBP3, CBB3, CYTC, MDH, MOXR, DUF58, VWA, PKC2, MOXZ gene in the chain window

PQ0_pqqBCDE.rule: anchor PQQC; in chain, window 3: PQQB and PQQE
PQ0_pqqBCDE.members: PQQA, PQQB, PQQC, PQQD, PQQE genes in the chain window

PQ1_pqq_orf7_orf6.rule: PQ0 plus ORF7 and ORF6 in chain, window 6 of the PQQC gene

H4_H4MPT_cluster.rule: anchor MCH; in chain, window 8: FAE and >= 2 H4X
H4_H4MPT_cluster.members: MCH, FAE, H4X genes in the chain window

LF_lutA_flank_chain.rule: anchor DUF6513; in chain, window 6: DUF447_N, AA_kinase, and Polyketide_cyc2 or 4HFCP_synth
LF_lutA_flank_chain.members: LFX genes in the chain window

TA_typeA_ABC_S58.rule: anchor S58; genes at oriented offsets -8..-1 on its contig (no strand rule, as the notes never tested it): >= 1 PBP6, >= 2 ABC, >= 1 BPD2; chain pass fraction reported
TA_typeA_ABC_S58.members: S58 + PBP6, ABC, BPD2 genes in that window (>= 5)

TB_typeB_core.rule: anchor LDC; window 6 on its contig, no strand rule: M20, THDPS, >= 2 TBX; chain pass fraction reported
TB_typeB_core.members: LDC + M20 + THDPS + TBX genes in window (>= 5)

nested_pairs: inner instance contained in an outer instance of the same family: X0 in X1, X1 in X2r, X1 in X2t, MX0 in MX1, PQ0 in PQ1, transporter genes (A, B, C, E, F, G) in LUT_RT and LUT_C. Frozen complete-cluster test: outer held = one locus covers >= 80% of the outer members; inner matched = a locus covers >= 80% of the inner members with inner members / locus span >= 0.8; nested = matched by a locus inside the holding locus.

boundary_negatives.B1_lanM_xoxF_head_to_head: notes' failed claim: LANMW | PQQDH neighbors head-to-head (left on -, right on +), gap <= 500 bp; X = LanM gene, Y = PQQDH with its chain partners within 3
boundary_negatives.B5_sbp5_lanM_transglycosylase: notes' failed claim: SBP_bac_5 + LANMW chain (first-pass M13w) with a TGL gene on the opposite strand within 7 genes; X = the chain pair, Y = TGL gene
boundary_negatives.B6_ycaO_tfuA_lanM: notes' failed claim: LANMW within 10 genes of a YcaO + TfuA pair on the opposite strand; X = LanM, Y = YcaO + TfuA
boundary_negatives.B7_xoxF_acylCoAdh_gap: notes' failed claim: PQQDH and ACAD neighbors on one strand with a gap > 500 bp; X = PQQDH, Y = ACAD
boundary_negatives.B2_rieske_xoxF_moco: added strand break (notes' validated module with an opposite-strand partner): PQQDH + RIESKE neighbors, MOCO on the opposite strand within 4 genes
boundary_negatives.B3_xoxFGJ_orf6_orf7: added strand break: X1 instance with ORF6 or ORF7 on the opposite strand within 10 genes
boundary_negatives.B4_lutA_DUF3280_flank: added strand break: lut instance (gold) with a D3280 gene within 2 genes of its first or last member on the opposite strand; Y = the LF chain genes of that D3280 when present, else the D3280 gene
boundary_negatives.outcomes: joined = a locus resolves the union interval (ribosomal_check: covers >= 80% of it, >= 80% of the locus inside); separated = a locus resolves X's interval and a locus resolves Y's interval; chance = the same 200 rigid translations of the union pattern

strata: family genome groups per instance = genome groups (frozen 0.75 groups) among instances of the same module whose member rescue3-token sets have Jaccard >= 0.5 with this instance (own instance included); strata 1, 2, >= 3; applied to the first-pass two-gene modules and to these larger modules
null: every element class (and every lut component's reverse-best genes for the LUT modules) shifted by an independent circular offset within each genome; 50 replicates, seed 17
